title: Impact of plastic-contaminated fuels on persistent organic pollutants in smoked beef: implications for sustainable food processing
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00592B, Paper

Do Hoang Giang, Nguyen Thu Uyen, Nguyen Thi Luyen, Nguyen Thi Thu Minh, Hoang Thuy Duong, Bui Thi Nhat Le, Luu Hai Nhi, Hoang Le Tuan Anh, Nguyen Ngoc Tung, Nguyen Tien Dat
Plastic-contaminated smoking fuels significantly increase PAHs, PCBs, and PCDD/Fs in smoked beef, highlighting food safety risks and the need for cleaner fuels in sustainable meat-processing practices.
